Alex Chen: hey all :wave: I'm Alex (joining infra). Trying to get access to Vault + our KMS for onboarding tasks (dev DB creds, test stripe keys). Who do I ping and what's the minimal request flow? Also, what's the rotation window so I don't ask for something permanent?

Maria Gonzales: welcome Alex! :tada: here's a quick path:
- fill the onboarding secrets form: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets (choose team: infra)
- opt into Okta group `secrets-readers` (DevEx can auto-add after the form)
- open an eng-security ticket for write/unseal/KMS roles
- request short-lived leases for dev work, avoid permanent keys

Tom Nguyen: <@Alex Chen> from security side, TL;DR:
- read-only Vault paths can be granted via the onboarding form. write/unseal/KMS require manager sign-off + eng-security review.
- rotation defaults: service/app secrets rotate every 90 days. developer CLI leases are short (typically 1h to 24h). If you need a longer TTL, justify it in the ticket.
- exceptions need approver name + reason. we try to avoid static plaintext secrets.

Maria Gonzales: tooling notes:
- after approvals you'll get a Slack DM from DevEx Bot with steps.
- dev fetch example:
```
vault kv get -field=password secret/team/infra/dev-db
```
- KMS access is gated by cloud IAM + KMS key bindings. For crypto ops we require an eng-security ticket.

DevEx Bot: Hi Alex — I created a placeholder workflow for your request. Steps:
1) submit the onboarding form (link above)
2) attach your manager's approval email to the ticket
3) wait for eng-security review (typically ~1 business day)
Helpful links: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/onboarding and https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/rotation

Alex Chen: great, thanks! I'll submit the form now and post the ticket link here when it's up.

Maria Gonzales: perfect. For expedite, put "onboarding: Alex Chen" in the ticket title and ping @Tom Nguyen.

Tom Nguyen: also, request dev-sandbox creds first (TTL 4h) instead of production keys — we can grant sandbox faster.

Alex Chen: requested sandbox creds and attached manager approval. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-4521. cc @Maria Gonzales. Thanks :thumbsup:
